summary: Observation of the movement of a globe illuminated by the setting sun; disappearance over the horizon: lack of information.
description: Recent testimony (September 11, 1979) of an earlier observation made in 1937 in eastern Martinique (the witness no longer remembers the date; January 1st is an arbitrarily given date). The witness reports seeing, at 6:00 PM, a globe, well-lit by the setting sun, moving slowly from west to east. The witness describes the phenomenon as having a diameter larger than the Moon. The phenomenon gradually disappeared below the horizon. The observation lasted nearly a minute. No other testimonies have been collected. GEIPAN classifies the case as C: lack of details.
